Why Choose AltuMED’s Medical Laboratory Billing Services

Lab billing is a complex process because of coding challenges and intricate payer policies. Failing to meet any of these requirements can result in denials, which can disrupt cash flow.

At AltuMED, we work to ensure you do not get trapped in the quagmire of any lab RCM challenges. We bring growth and stability to your lab revenue through:

  • 16 years of experience in laboratory RCM
  • 97% first-pass acceptance rate
  • 21-30 A/R days
  • Dedicated denial management teams with CARC/RARC code analytics dashboards

Adding to all this is the RCMOS system that works alongside our expert billing team. This system provides automation, accuracy, and RCM intelligence, all in a single platform.

Faster Collections with AR Laboratory Billing Services

Accounts Receivable has a major influence on cash flow. At AltuMED, we use aggressive, technology-driven AR management techniques to ensure you get quick reimbursements. Our denial management teams track the root causes of payment delays and apply fixes. Their prompt action helps ensure reduced outstanding balances.

See How We Cut A/R Days to 21-30

Industries and Labs We Serve

AltuMED’s laboratory billing services fulfill the needs of:

Genetic testing labs

Toxicology labs

Biological labs

Pathology labs

Molecular labs

Diagnostic imaging & specialty clinical labs

Our services cover both medical and forensic testing. With the customizability of RCMOS and the expertise of a billing team that understands the nuances of every aspect of lab revenue cycle management, you can rest assured that you are all set to get a maximized cash inflow.

Laboratory CPT and LOINC Code Mastery

We offer precision billing for 100+ test types. Here are the examples:

Chemistry & Immunology

  • Basic Metabolic: 80048
  • Lipid Panel: 80061
  • HbA1c: 83036

Pathology & Histology

  • Surgical Pathology: 88305 (Level IV)
  • Cytopathology: 88112 (Pap smear)

Toxicology & Drug Testing

  • UA Screening: 80307 (Qualitative)
  • Confirmatory: 82542 (LC/MS), G0480 (Medicare)
  • Pain Management: 83925

Molecular & Genetic

  • Infectious Disease: 87804 (COVID), 87521 (HPV)
  • Genetic Panels: 81227 (BRCA1), 81479 (Oncology)
Claim Your Exclusive Coding Audit

LIS and EHR Integration Ecosystem

We integrate your existing patient records with our system using secure HL7/FHIR and SFTP. Here is how this integration system works:

  • Connecting with top LIS and EHR-linked lab modules: Epic Beaker, Cerner PathNet, Sunquest, Orchard, Meditech
  • Auto-charge capture: Rules engine extracts billable tests from LIS orders
  • Result↔billing sync: Prevent mismatched orders/results at posting

The system ensuring all of this connectivity is RCMOS, our very own revenue cycle software. It helps ensure that your LIS and EHR data remains synchronized with billing and payer rules.

Comprehensive Lab Billing Process Modified For Your Practice

Our seven-step billing process is a carefully strategized framework to prevent revenue leakage and speed up reimbursements.

Patient Registration and Insurance Verification

  • Capturing complete demographic and insurance details
  • Confirming coverage
  • Verifying eligible lab services

ICD-10 and CPT Coding

Our coders look into all the specific requirements of laboratory billing and select the most appropriate CPT and ICD-10 codes. This step gets optimum support from the RCMOS's Automated Revenue Engine.

AI-Powered Claim Scrubbing

Claim scrubbing is an essential operation of the RCMOS-powered workflow. It is a strong algorithm that:

  • Flags mismatched CPT/LOINC pairs and missing medical necessity
  • Predicts payer-specific denials
  • Automatically adds modifiers (like QW and 91) based on test complexity and repeat frequency

HIPAA-Compliant EDI Claim Submission

As an industry-wide established EDI practice, we submit your claims according to ANSI X12 5010 standards. But this is not all about “digital faxing” the claims. We make sure that every patient demographic, CPT code, and CLIA number adheres to HIPAA transaction rules.

Here is how this process works:

  • Intelligent claim routing
  • Pre-submission scrubbing using RCMOS's Built-in AI system
  • Active tracking of every claim post-submission

Follow-Up and Denial Management

We follow up on all submitted claims to ensure smooth reimbursements. Although we ensure the flawlessness of the process, we realize the possibility of unexpected denials. So we work pre-emptively before they can affect your cash flow. We also take notice of payment delays and perform diligent AR management.

Patient Balance Recovery with Automated Notifications

Our system automatically generates invoices for patients with outstanding balances. To help them clear dues easily, we offer them specialized dashboards with multiple payment options. For instance, we use:

  • Self-serve portal with card, ACH, HSA options; no-login pay link
  • Payment plans with auto-reminders (email/SMS)

Reporting and KPI Tracking

We give you access to interactive dashboards where you can look into your RCM status. These digital portals allow you to view reports based on your preferred KPIs. There also are filters, which allow you to view your processes from any angle you want. This reporting mechanism helps you adjust your revenue strategy for maximum cash flow.

RCMOS: Our Comprehensive Laboratory Billing Software

RCM innovation through automation is not a new concept. Many lab revenue solutions offer automation and strategic support. But what most of them do not offer is system integration. They consist of standalone components, each of which handles a specific operation but doesn't communicate with the others. As a result, discrepancies occur, which nullifies the automation advantage to a great extent.

Enter RCMOS, a system that combines automation, analytics, and human action into one platform. It is designed in such a way that eradicates revenue woes typically caused by siloed systems. It also performs continuous eligibility checks and claim scrubbing and automates follow-ups.

That said, the RCM Operating system doesn’t undermine the importance of the human workforce. It actually amplifies their output exponentially. This helps ensure you see fewer denials, faster payments, and little to no manual rework.

For quantification’s sake, this system can reduce denials by up to 40% and shorten AR aging to a 21-30-day range for high-volume diagnostic, molecular, and pathology labs. It also ensures proper interoperability by connecting LIS/EHR data, payer policies, and AR workflows into one system. And it uses cutting-edge AI tech and ML systems that can learn from existing data and perform complex reasoning to improve performance in real time.
